summary: The audited frozen same-day Deribit screen stopped at its 90-minute hard deadline with 10 complete BTC/ETH asset-block transitions versus 12 required and 1,028 GEX-computable trades. Sample-first truth is inconclusive. Descriptively, pooled Spearman (+0.0667), both per-asset correlations (+0.4/+0.2), and leave-one-out stability (0.2) failed; only the negative/positive dealer-GEX next-RV ratio (1.1669) passed. No week-long wait, alpha, return, or deployment claim.

official_semantics_verified.heartbeat: public/set_heartbeat REQUIRES params {interval: N}; params {} returns -32602 Invalid params {reason: value required, param: interval}. With interval=10 the reply is result: ok and the client answers heartbeat notifications with public/test.

byte_caps.accounting: exact encoded payload bytes; flush + os.fsync on every record
byte_caps.startup: reconcile_existing() sums every dayYYYYMMDD directory except today's; today's existing bytes are loaded into the active-day counter at first rotate; rotation folds active bytes into the prior pool exactly once
byte_caps.rotation_record: the day_rotation_open event is itself checked against both caps, so a restart cannot bypass them

restart with 918 pre-existing bytes blocked immediately with zero debris bytes written

superseded_optional_data.what: day20260830 ticker.jsonl (~78 MiB, 96327 records) and the bulk of instruments.jsonl were produced by the earlier ticker-heavy configuration
superseded_optional_data.status: SUPERSEDED optional smoke data — retained as evidence, never deleted, and NOT part of the default configuration
superseded_optional_data.gamma_zero_note: 13475 of those 96327 ticker records carry gamma == 0.0 from the venue's 1e-5 quantization on deep-OTM / short-dated rows: valid data contributing exactly 0.0, not a missing greek

counterfactual_diagnostics.no_backtest_possible: taker-flow GEX cannot be backtested from public streams alone: no authorized 1 ms raw access, undocumented venue retention, and no lawful complete historical taker-level option tape in the local dataset
counterfactual_diagnostics.two_sided_flow_caveat: 100 ms aggregation can merge a taker buy and a taker sell into one print; without raw 1 ms the intra-window split is unobservable (affects sub-100 ms structure, not daily aggregates)
counterfactual_diagnostics.model_derived_gamma: under the default configuration gamma is model-derived: standard Black-Scholes gamma from the trade's own exchange-published iv (%), instrument strike and expiration_timestamp, and S = trade index_price. It is labeled greeks_source = bs_from_trade_iv and is explicitly NOT a venue greek; it inherits Black-Scholes assumptions and the venue's IV convention.
counterfactual_diagnostics.venue_gamma_join_tolerance: when ticker records exist (optional flag or superseded data) gamma is joined from the nearest ticker within a 2 h tolerance and labeled greeks_source = deribit_ticker

data_limitations.prospective_only: The same-day screen used only capture after campaign creation and stopped at the frozen 2026-08-30T18:31:13Z deadline. Ten transitions are below the registered twelve-transition minimum.
data_limitations.trade_arrival_is_bursty: Option prints arrive in bursts. The final frozen prefix held 2,794 raw trade records; 2,770 were at or before the deadline-clamped cutoff, 2,768 were GEX-computable, and 1,028 belonged to the ten complete included transitions.
data_limitations.storage: 256 MiB per UTC day with fail-closed shutdown; cumulative default 10 GiB via --max-total-bytes; prior capture is never auto-deleted
data_limitations.no_intraday_greek_surface_by_default: without --capture-tickers there is no stored venue greek surface; only per-trade model-derived gamma is available
data_limitations.raw_once_semantics: raw JSONL is AT-LEAST-ONCE across restarts (bounded trades rehydrate window); every record carries a deterministic dedup id and run.py's replay dedup is the authoritative exactly-once view. The raw layer itself never claims to prevent restart duplicates.

prospective_requirements.sampling_disposition: Complete at the 90-minute hard cap. Do not wait a week or extend this frozen screen.

decisions.status_why: Only the registered twelve-transition condition failed (10 observed). Three of four descriptive gates were false, but sample-first truth remains inconclusive.
decisions.returns_csv: Absent by contract: realized volatility is a risk descriptive, not a tradable return.
decisions.variants: No promotion or rescue. Any new test needs a separately preregistered mechanism and event-count stop.
